snippet.title: Noah's Bottle v2.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
Noah’s Bottle is a rhythm game that automatically generates its notes. You can use any music you like in your devices.You can also compose your own music by creating your own music script. 

The new Noah’s Bottle ver 2.0 added “Rhythm Mode” that includes 40 piano songs.All songs were reproduced by real time performance of the original recording, which gives the player a wonderful sense of live performing experience.
